name: Chandpur
registryAssessment: Bangladesh's official Ministry of Land map.land.gov.bd public mouza-and-plot map service is evidenced for Chandpur district and Chandpur Sadar: its anonymous point cascade identified the exact WUP point as Chandpur Sadar, Ward No-12. This establishes an official public local map/procedure context, not complete citywide cadastral coverage or legal title records.

queries.query: Chandpur Bangladesh official cadastral map parcel land records map API
queries.result: Found the official Ministry of Land mouza/plot map viewer, the DLRS Settlement map-search portal, the Ministry of Land citizen-services page, the official Chandpur district portal, and an official LGED Chandpur map directory. The Ministry viewer describes digitized/georeferenced mouza maps and exposes public map and plot-selection controls.

queries.query: চাঁদপুর সরকারি ভূমি নকশা মৌজা মানচিত্র খতিয়ান অনলাইন
queries.result: Found the official Bengali Ministry of Land map viewer and DLRS/Settlement sources. The viewer provides বিভাগ/জেলা/থানা-উপজেলা/মৌজা/শিট/প্লট selectors and states that mouza map sheets are digitized and geo-referenced; the official cascade returned Chittagong division, Chandpur district, Chandpur Sadar and Ward No-12 for the WUP point.

officialSources.role: Ministry of Land public mouza/plot map viewer
officialSources.observation: HTTP 200. Current HTML/JavaScript inspected. The page exposes OpenLayers controls, POST routes /getAdminByCode, /GetCascadeGeom and /getGeomByCode, and identifies the GIS backend host gis.land.gov.bd. Session-backed anonymous cascade requests identified the WUP point as geocode 201322, Chandpur Sadar, Ward No-12.
HTTP 200. The official page exposes division, district, survey, upazila/thana, mouza, sheet and dag/plot selectors and states it is planned/implemented by the Directorate of Land Records and Surveys.
Directory listing exposes Chandpur district map files and subdirectories for its upazilas; these are general map evidence, not parcel-vector evidence.

geometryDecision.reason: No exact-point parcel polygon with a safe stable native parcel identity was obtained. The viewer returned administrative boundary WKT for the point, but the official GeoServer capabilities request returned HTTP 503 and parcel geometry requires a selected mouza/table/plot context. No administrative boundary was retained as a parcel sample.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official national mouza/plot digital land-zoning and map-search services.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official viewer presence and exact WUP-point administrative cascade to Chandpur Sadar Ward No-12 verified; exact parcel inclusion, public parcel-vector availability, complete city coverage, cadastral/legal status and CRS for parcel geometry were not verified.
